base: vintage 19th-century storybook pen-and-ink engraving, black and white line art, fine cross-hatching and stippling, etching illustration, clean off-white background, light airy line art, mostly white, pure line art (NOT watercolor, no grey wash, NOT dark). WIDE HORIZONTAL LANDSCAPE orientation, 3:2 aspect ratio, much wider than tall. RECURRING CHARACTER (must look identical in every image): an anthropomorphic parrot as a Victorian gentleman-businessman: plump feathered body, large curved beak, short feather crest on his head, feathers rendered in fine hatching, three-piece tweed suit, long overcoat, bowler hat, monocle on a chain, leather briefcase. SECOND RECURRING CHARACTERS (when mentioned): anthropomorphic worker ants as tiny diligent shop clerks: slender insect bodies, simple work aprons and flat caps, all nearly identical; the ELDER ANT is distinguished by tiny round wire spectacles and a knotted neck scarf. IMPORTANT SCALE RULE: the ants are TINY, about knee-height to the parrot, all ants exactly the same size; the parrot is a normal townsfolk-sized gentleman, never gigantic relative to the buildings around him. Setting: a cobblestone medieval-European fairytale town with half-timbered Tudor houses, twisted old trees and lamp posts; other anthropomorphic animals (rabbits, badgers, foxes, birds) as townsfolk in period clothing may appear in the background. CRITICAL RULE FOR FRAMES AND SIGNS: any framed picture, poster, sign, plaque or document appearing in the scene contains ONLY faint abstract hatched scribble lines, completely illegible, purely decorative. NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO signage lettering, NO numbers, NO logos, no color.

images.scene: Medium heroic shot in the town square: the parrot businessman standing proudly on the cobblestones, chest puffed out, one wing pressed flat on his chest in a grand orator's pose, the other wing holding his leather briefcase, beak slightly raised; a few townsfolk animals strolling in the background.

Eye-level portrait in front of his shop: the parrot businessman proudly gesturing with one open wing toward his storefront: a charming half-timbered shop with a bay window, striped awning and a hanging wooden sign (the sign is completely blank, only faint decorative hatching). IMPORTANT: the ants do NOT appear in this image, not a single ant; the only characters are the parrot and (if mentioned) non-insect townsfolk animals.

Wide interior shot of an immaculate little general store run entirely by tiny ants: perfectly ordered shelves, dozens of tiny worker ants in aprons moving in calm orderly flow, carrying parcels up little wooden ramps and ladders, weighing goods on a small brass scale, serving animal customers; the walls are completely bare, nothing hangs on them; at the doorway stands the parrot businessman, large and astonished, bowler hat held in his wing.

Close shot inside the ants' store: the parrot businessman bent forward, monocle raised to his eye, inspecting a completely BARE smooth wooden wall where nothing hangs; at his feet tiny worker ants hurry past carrying small parcels, ignoring him, busy and content.

View from the cobblestone street through the large front window of the ants' store: the parrot businessman seen from behind and slightly to the side, pressed near the glass, peeking inside; within the shop, the tiny elder ant with round spectacles demonstrates folding a parcel with precise gestures while a younger ant beside her repeats exactly the same gesture with her own parcel.
